Description.Name: Seoyun Hammerick
Description.Details: Seoyun may be getting old and grey by most MechWarrior standards, but her callsign, "Anvil", is much older and has become a title reverently handed down through several generations. Younger MechWarriors often guess at the origins of the callsign and most, much to Seoyun's amusement, never get close to the truth. A steadfast and meticulous individual, Seoyun has spent many campaigns being a consistent and persevering presence for her compatriots while remaining a calculating and inevitable threat to her foes.
